verdict.rationale: Cooley GO's Delaware incorporation package explicitly generates founder vesting mechanics via Restricted Stock Purchase Agreements, and the same package auto-includes Section 83(b) Election forms, Joint Escrow Instructions, and Stock Assignment documents when stock is subject to vesting — directly covering vesting and 83(b). Community corroboration confirms Cooley GO addresses 'allocating initial founder equity' issues. Missing for 10: no explicit standalone guidance content on co-founder equity split methodology/formulas beyond the document generator and community mention.
